name: Fast Shear-Warp with Runlength Encoding
aliases: Shear-Warp with Lacroute and Levoy Implementation
definition: A fast shear-warp method that uses a runlength-encoded (RLE) volume for each principal axis to skip transparent voxels.
summary: Fast Shear-Warp with Runlength Encoding is a scanline-based volume rendering algorithm that skips transparent voxels and occluded pixels using run-length encoding to significantly reduce shading operations.
